description: A young man in a dark suit and headphones works a brass telegraph key at a wooden desk in a cramped wood-panelled cabin. Behind him, an older man in a peaked cap with a badge leans in and watches. A sparking spark-gap transmitter with blue electric arcs stands in a glass-walled box, a glowing oil lantern sits on the desk, and a round porthole on the left shows a moonlit sea. Brass and wood equipment, a paper form and an ink bottle are on the desk. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
